findings.message: Await the registration check before testing its result. `isRegistered` returns a Promise, so negating it always yields `false`. Scanning a participant who is not registered therefore bypasses this rejection and creates a check-in anyway. Await the result before negating it so event registration is actually enforced.

Prevent repeated scans while a check-in is pending. `CredentialScanner` enables repeated detections with `allowMultiple={true}` and `scanDelay={0}`, but this handler posts on every detection until a response closes the dialog. Holding a QR code in view can consequently submit overlapping check-ins: both requests can pass `isCheckedIn`, after which one fails the database uniqueness constraint. Pause scanning or guard submissions while a request is pending.

Show the scanner independently of staff registration status. This scanner trigger is inside the `!isRegistered` branch. A staff member who is also registered for the event therefore loses the only control that opens the check-in dialog and cannot check in attendees through the page. Move the staff scanner control outside the registration-status condition.
